the enzyme described here is an endopeptidase with high homology to rat EC 3.24.15.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a metallopropeptidase is present in Alzheimer's disease brains, which is capable of degrading APP and generating the 15-kDa A beta precursor.
a protease has been purified and characterized from Alzheimer's disease and control brain which can degrade APP and generate A beta.
a protease with a molecular weight of about 4.2 kDa was purified from Alzheimer's disease brains.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the protease we have identified in Alzheimer's disease brain is able to degrade the APP and generate A beta, and therefore may be involved in the generation and/or degradation of this peptide in Alzheimer's disease.
a novel, amyloidogenic metalloproteolytic pathway may be involved in the processing of APP in Alzheimer's disease.
